leonos-apps.reason: Native desktop, service, graphics and application interfaces. Embedded dependencies remain part of their actual consumers.

leonos-fastfetch.reason: Retain the verified custom release with LeonOS Logo. The future real local APK must depend on !fastfetch. This manifest does not enforce that conflict.

musl.reason: Password-file locking patch and loader ABI require validation before replacing the running system libc. No fabricated musl provides.

leonos-mimalloc.reason: LeonOS runtime allocator contract; statically linked copies belong to their consumers.

leonos-musl-dev.reason: Default-installed headers, startup objects and static libraries generated from the exact runtime musl sysroot. The APK builder assigns their exact file paths when packaging and repackaging roots.

busybox.reason: Transfer /bin/sh and applet symlinks together after shell, init and installer regressions. Separately installed utilities retain their own paths.

authentication.reason: PAM patches and pam_leonos_password need real local packaging; preserve policy, setuid modes and login semantics before any upstream replacement.

auth-support-libraries.reason: Upstream dependencies of shadow; transfer headers, libraries and metadata with authentication consumers.

storage-util-linux.reason: Includes split libraries and command packages; resolve actual repository file ownership before choosing subpackages. Installer relies on these tools.

storage-filesystems.reason: Transfer formatter/checker aliases with commands; preserve ext2 installer behavior.

editors.reason: Generic tools; transfer commands and runtime data together, then remove old built-in producers.

ncurses.reason: Resolve terminal data/tools split and libraries from repository metadata; preserve leonos TERM support.

nano.reason: A real standalone nano package lets apk replace its complete payload with upstream nano.

ca-certificates-bundle.reason: The actual CA bundle is packaged separately so curl dependencies and authenticated upstream updates can own it.

file.reason: Binary, libmagic and magic.mgc must be transferred as a matching version set.

lua.reason: Current liblua.so.5 and /opt/lua layout require native consumer migration; no false SONAME compatibility links.

sqlite.reason: Current custom SONAME and native consumers need migration before upstream library replacement.

trust.reason: Transfer trust data via authenticated packages; validate certificate update triggers on LeonOS.

leonos-base.reason: Fallback distribution inventory, not proof of an individual package producer. Includes kernel, boot, identity and layout; review every fallback before generating APKs.
